    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractGameSession
    Abstract base for all game sessions, providing shared infrastructure.
    AbstractLetterProgression
    Base class for letter progressions that share cursor management.

    CameraService
    Captures live frames from the default webcam using OpenCV and converts them to JavaFX Image objects for display in GameUI.
    ConfigLoader
    Loads local configuration from config.properties at the project root.
    DifficultyProgression
    Letter progression ordered by difficulty tier (easiest → hardest).
    DynamicGestureDefinition
    Represents a dynamic ASL gesture defined by a sequence of hand poses over time.
    GameConfig
    Central configuration for game settings and constants.
    GameEventListener
    Observer interface for game session events.
    GameMode
    Enumerates the two supported game modes in the ASL learning platform.
    GameResult
    Common contract for the summary produced at the end of any game session.
    GameSession
    Unified contract for all game sessions.
    GameSessionFactory
    Factory for creating game sessions.
    GameUI
    Main JavaFX UI for the ASL learning platform.
    GestureDefinition
    Abstract base class representing an ASL gesture definition.
    GestureDefinitionTest
    Unit tests for the GestureDefinition class Verifies correct construction, immutability guarantees, and string formatting
    GestureGate
    Gates incoming gesture detections by a minimum confidence threshold.
    GestureLibrary
    Loads and provides access to ASL reference gesture definitions from JSON files.
    GestureRecognizer
    Defines the contract for gesture recognition in the ASL learning platform.
    GestureType
    Enumerates the possible types of ASL gestures.
    HandLandmark
    Represents a single hand landmark point in a 3D Space (akin to Point3D in Java) as detected by Mediapipe Each hand contains 21 total landmarks corresponding to specific joints and keypoints This class is immutable; (x,y and z) coordinates are final and cannot be modified
    HandLandMarkTest
    Unit tests for the HandLandmark class Verifies correct construction, getters, edge cases and string formatting
    LandmarkBridge
    Bridges the Python MediaPipe landmark extractor to the Java recognition layer.
    LandmarkBridge.LandmarkBridgeException
    Exception thrown when the landmark bridge encounters an unrecoverable error.
    LandmarkUtils
    Utility class providing stateless landmark transformation operations.
    LetterDifficulty
    Defines the difficulty ordering of ASL letters based on hand pose complexity.
    LetterProgression
    Defines the sequence of ASL letters presented during a game session.
    LoadInstruction
    Encapsulates the instruction video player for the ASL learning platform.
    Main
    Main entry point for the ASL Recognition and Learning Platform.
    MediaPipeRecognizer
    A GestureRecognizer implementation that compares hand landmark positions using cosine similarity to compute a confidence score.
    MockGestureRecognizer
    A test-only implementation of GestureRecognizer that returns a configurable, hardcoded recognition result
    NoOpGameEventListener
    No-op implementation of GameEventListener.
    PerfectBonusScoringStrategy
    Scoring strategy that awards a perfect-run bonus on top of the base score.
    PlayerState
    Tracks the in-game state common to all game modes for a single player.
    PracticeResult
    Immutable result for a completed practice session.
    PracticeSession
    Single-player practice session: A → Z, each letter requires PerfectBonusScoringStrategy.getRequiredSuccesses() consecutive passes.
    RecognitionResult
    Represents the result of a single gesture recognition attempt Contains a confidence score indicating how closely the user's hand pose matched the target gesture, along with the closest matching gesture definition found This class is immutable; all fields are set at construction and cannot be modified
    ScoringStrategy
    Strategy interface for evaluating recognition accuracy and computing scores.
    SequentialProgression
    Sequential progression through ASL letters A → Z.
    StandardScoringStrategy
    Flat scoring strategy: score = floor(accuracy × 100) × tier.

    UserProgress
    In-session view of a user's learning progress.
    UserProgress
    Persistence-layer representation of a user's learning progress.
